$comment: Checked-in source of truth for the Microsoft Graph identifiers referenced by deploy/azure/infra/entra/app-registration.bicep. Update this file first, then the module; eng/tests/azure-graph-registration.test.mjs asserts the module matches.

sources.what: Delegated permission (OAuth2 scope) IDs for openid, profile, and email

openid.why: Mandatory for OpenID Connect; yields the sub, oid, and tid claims the first-owner allowlist keys on.

profile.why: Yields name and preferred_username for the account display surface.

email.why: Yields the email claim when the directory has one. Treated as mutable and never used for authorization.
